note: Committed measured baseline for the catch-all shell, Slow 4G + 4x CPU, commit 1c74603 (2026-10-28). Values are the median of 3 runs against the synthetic releaseFixture (the path CI takes); the first run of a session is discarded as warm-up because a cold page cache inflates TBT by ~2x. Observed spread across the stable runs: desktop TBT 150-184 ms, mobile 99-148 ms, LCP 3.02-3.22 s, so host load moves these by roughly +/-25%. Only the 2x blowup guard reads them, which is why they are allowed to be approximate; bundle bytes are gated deterministically elsewhere (check-bundle.mjs). Regenerate with: node scripts/perf-probe.mjs --json. TBT here is the standard definition: sum over long tasks of max(0, duration - 50ms), NOT the raw sum of task durations. host records the machine the baseline was taken on: TBT is wall-clock and scales with core count as well as load, so a run on a different core count is not comparable and the gate skips it. The GitHub runner is ubuntu-latest (2-4 cores) and measured 271-321 ms against this 16-core baseline of 164/132 ms.
